media.title: MGM Years — document gallery
media.description: Document gallery for Kaper's MGM/Hollywood years. Includes Polish and American press coverage, studio-era publicity, reviews, and contextual images from 1934–1938. SRC0041 is represented here as a Nasz Przegląd Ilustrowany 1934 clipped press image showing Kaper, not as a separate standalone Media record within this gallery.
